notablePrerequisites:
Market Festival attached to any other mana-producing land you control.
Argothian Elder does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate the land with Market Festival attached by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Market Festival triggers, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Argothian Elder.
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping the land with Market Festival attached and Wirewood Lodge.
Repeat.
